description: This file declares the EmulatePrecision class, which is responsible for gathering compound assignments from an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) and generating functions to emulate precision in shader code. It includes methods for visiting various AST nodes, writing helper functions, and managing internal function mappings related to precision emulation.

classes.description: A class that gathers compound assignments from the AST and generates functions for precision emulation in shaders.
